description: Source code for the OutputCommitCoordinator class in Apache Spark, managing output commit permissions in distributed stages.

classes.name: OutputCommitCoordinator
classes.description: Manages coordination of output commits across stages and tasks in Spark, enforcing a 'first committer wins' policy.

classes.name: OutputCommitCoordinator.OutputCommitCoordinatorEndpoint
classes.description: RPC endpoint for handling permission requests and stopping the coordinator.

methods.name: canCommit
methods.description: Checks if a task attempt is authorized to commit output.

methods.name: stageStart
methods.description: Initializes or reuses stage state when a stage begins.

methods.name: stageEnd
methods.description: Removes stage state when a stage completes.

methods.name: taskCompleted
methods.description: Updates stage state based on task completion and success or failure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the coordinator, notifying the driver if applicable.

methods.name: handleAskPermissionToCommit
methods.description: Handles permission requests for task output commits.
